name: Resource Conservation Workshop
what_you_do: A week of field study, tours and hands-on sessions about saving natural resources. You also hear talks about college and jobs.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th to 12th graders from North Carolina.
deadline_text: 2027 workshop is June 13-18, 2027. Applications open Jan 15, 2027 and close March 31, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply through your local NC Soil and Water Conservation District. Deadlines differ by district. They are usually in late March. Contact the co-coordinators listed on the page (Liz Driscoll, liz_driscoll@ncsu.edu, 919.886.3424).
notes: Your district chooses you and pays the $650 fee. Districts favor rising juniors and seniors. You can attend only once. Awards and scholarships are given to students at the workshop.
